title: Initiative: SLO Tracker & Playbook for Cross-Team Reliability Programs
creator: Marina Lee
description: Deliver a product-facing initiative tracker and operational playbook that standardizes SLI definitions, SLO targets, error-budget lifecycle, and escalation flows across Redwood product teams. The deliverable will: 1) provide a templated SLI/SLO schema and YAML spec stored in a central repo, 2) surface per-initiative error-budget state and burn rate in the Redwood Console, 3) wire automated notifications and suggested mitigations when budgets approach thresholds, and 4) include an OKR-aligned dashboard for leadership to see initiative health over a quarter. Goal: reduce cross-team ambiguity on reliability targets and speed up remediation when SLOs are at risk.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Central SLO schema (YAML) defined and merged in git with validator (unit tests pass). 2) Console dashboard shows initiative-level SLOs, current burn rate, and projected breach probability per SLO. 3) Notification pipeline triggers (Slack + PagerDuty stub) when budget loss > 40% in 24h and when projected breach < 72h. 4) Playbook doc published in Confluence with runbook steps and postmortem template. 5) Two pilot teams (Hosting and Embeddings) onboarded and report improved time-to-detect by >= 25% during pilot window.
success_metrics: - Time-to-detect SLO breaches (median) reduced by 25% for pilot teams. - Number of ad-hoc reliability questions reduced by 40% in PM/Eng Slack channel. - 90% of new initiatives declare SLIs at kickoff using the template. - Console adoption: 3 internal teams using initiative dashboard by end of cycle.
risks_and_mitigation: - Risk: SLI definitions vary by team and may not map to a single schema. Mitigation: include flexible 'custom_tags' and 'sli_type' enums and run 1:1 workshops during scoping. - Risk: Console telemetry quota/ingest cost spike. Mitigation: introduce sampling and TTL-based aggregation for historical SLI metrics. - Risk: Ownership ambiguity on escalations. Mitigation: define clear on-call handoff and tie playbook steps to team-owned escalation policies.
milestones: - 2026-03-05: Kickoff and cross-functional scoping complete. - 2026-03-12: Draft SLI schema + validator prototype. - 2026-03-18: Console wireframes and dashboard prototype reviewed with Design. - 2026-03-30: Integration PR (ENG) and Confluence playbook v1. - 2026-04-10: Pilot onboarded (Hosting, Embeddings). - 2026-04-20: Initiative review and sign-off.

2026-03-09 — Trade-off discussion: central storage in git is simpler for auditability; config service enables dynamic edits. Decided to prototype git-backed schema with a follow-up ticket for dynamic sync (ENG-4467).
2026-03-11 — Security note from Compliance (Ellen R.) — ensure SLI telemetry paths exclude PII. Added to acceptance criteria and security checklist.

Feedback: expose 'project-level' and 'initiative-level' toggles, and surface recommended mitigations in the UI (e.g., reduce batch size, fallback to lightweight model). Action: create ENG tasks for mitigation recipe integration (ENG-4602).
next_actions: 1) ENG to complete dynamic sync spike (ENG-4467) and estimate effort for live edits. 2) Design to hand off component assets (DES-612). 3) Create onboarding checklist for pilot teams and schedule 1:1s with Hosting and Embeddings. 4) Wire up Slack notification prototype (internal channel #slo-alerts).
owner_notes: Prefer fast iteration: ship schema + console read-only dashboard in this cycle, follow up with write/edit flows and alerting automation next cycle. Will treat the initial delivery as 'pilot mode' and iterate based on pilot feedback.
